title: Sam’s Prairie Adventure
moral: Be brave, be smart, and never give up.

scenes.summary: Sam rides his horse Dusty across the prairie with a mission.
scenes.text: Sam rides his horse Dusty across the bright prairie carrying marbles for children in the next town.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy riding horse across golden prairie with blue sky, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Sam encounters a dangerous broken cliff path.
scenes.text: Sam finds the path broken near a cliff and realizes it is unsafe to continue.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy and horse stopping near dangerous cliff edge, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Sam searches carefully for a safer path.
scenes.text: Sam finds a hidden path and slowly leads Dusty through it.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy leading horse through tall grass narrow path, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Sam clears a rock blocking the path.
scenes.text: Sam pushes a big rock away to clear the path forward.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy pushing big rock while horse watches, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Sam reaches the town and shares marbles with the children.
scenes.text: Sam arrives safely and gives marbles to happy children.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy giving marbles to happy children in town, colorful cartoon children's book style

story: Sam rides his horse Dusty across the bright prairie carrying marbles for children in the next town. Sam finds the path broken near a cliff and realizes it is unsafe to continue. Sam finds a hidden path and slowly leads Dusty through it. Sam pushes a big rock away to clear the path forward. Sam arrives safely and gives marbles to happy children.
